Require Import Metalib.Metatheory Infrastructure target_inf.

Definition kleene_equiv t1 t2 :=
  exists k, t1 ->* (trm_lit k) /\ t2 ->* (trm_lit k).

Fixpoint appctx (ctx : cc) (t : exp) : exp :=
  match ctx with
  | cc_Empty => t
  | cc_Lam x c => trm_abs (close_exp_wrt_exp x (appctx c t))
  | cc_AppL c t2 => trm_app (appctx c t) t2
  | cc_AppR t1 c => trm_app t1 (appctx c t)
  | cc_PairL c t2 => trm_pair (appctx c t) t2
  | cc_PairR t1 c => trm_pair t1 (appctx c t)
  | cc_Co co c => trm_capp co (appctx c t)
  | cc_Rcd l c => trm_rcd l (appctx c t)
  | cc_Proj c l => trm_proj (appctx c t) l
  end.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import target_inf.

Definition relation := exp -> exp -> Prop.

Section Star.

Variable R : relation.

Inductive star: relation :=
  | star_refl: forall a,
      star a a
  | star_step: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> star a c.

Definition irred a : Prop := forall b, ~(R a b).

End Star.

Notation "[ z ~> u ] e" := (subst_exp u z e) (at level 0).

Notation "t ^^ u"       := (open_exp_wrt_exp t u) (at level 67).

Notation "e ^ x"        := (open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x)).

Notation "c |= T1 ~> T2" := (cotyp c T1 T2) (at level 69).

Notation "E |= t ~: T" := (typing E t T) (at level 69).

Notation "R 'star'" := (star R) (at level 69).

Notation "t ->* t'" := (step star t t') (at level 68).

Notation "'|' A '|'" := (ptyp2styp A) (at level 60).

Notation "'∥' Γ '∥'" := (map ptyp2styp Γ) (at level 60).

Notation "A ≺: B ⇝ co " := (sub A B co) (at level 45).

Notation "Γ ⊢ E ⇒ A ⇝ t" := (has_type Γ E Inf A t) (at level 45).

Notation "Γ ⊢ E ⇐ A ⇝ t" := (has_type Γ E Chk A t) (at level 45).

Notation "x '#' E" := (x \notin (dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Definition env := list (atom * exp).

Require Import Coq.Logic.FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export syntax_ott.

Scheme typ_ind' := Induction for typ Sort Prop.

Definition typ_mutind :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 =>
  typ_ind' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6.

Scheme typ_rec' := Induction for typ Sort Set.

Definition typ_mutrec :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 =>
  typ_rec' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6.

Scheme co_ind' := Induction for co Sort Prop.

Definition co_mutind :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 H12 H13 =>
  co_ind' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 H12 H13.

Scheme co_rec' := Induction for co Sort Set.

Definition co_mutrec :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 H12 H13 =>
  co_rec' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 H12 H13.

Scheme exp_ind' := Induction for exp Sort Prop.

Definition exp_mutind :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 =>
  exp_ind' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11.

Scheme exp_rec' := Induction for exp Sort Set.

Definition exp_mutrec :=
  fun H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11 =>
  exp_rec' H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H11.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : var) (e1 : exp) {struct e1} : exp :=
  match e1 with
    | trm_var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (trm_var_b n1) else (trm_var_f x2)
    | trm_var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (trm_var_b n2) else (trm_var_b (S n2))
    | trm_unit => trm_unit
    | trm_lit i1 => trm_lit i1
    | trm_abs e2 => trm_abs (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S n1) x1 e2)
    | trm_app e2 e3 => trm_app (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e3)
    | trm_pair e2 e3 => trm_pair (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e3)
    | trm_rcd l1 e2 => trm_rcd l1 (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2)
    | trm_proj e2 l1 => trm_proj (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2) l1
    | trm_capp c1 e2 => trm_capp c1 (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2)
  end.

Definition close_exp_wrt_exp x1 e1 := close_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 x1 e1.

Fixpoint size_typ (T1 : typ) {struct T1} : nat :=
  match T1 with
    | a_nat => 1
    | a_unit => 1
    | a_arrow T2 T3 => 1 + (size_typ T2) + (size_typ T3)
    | a_prod T2 T3 => 1 + (size_typ T2) + (size_typ T3)
    | a_rcd l1 T2 => 1 + (size_typ T2)
  end.

Fixpoint size_co (c1 : co) {struct c1} : nat :=
  match c1 with
    | co_id => 1
    | co_trans c2 c3 => 1 + (size_co c2) + (size_co c3)
    | co_top => 1
    | co_arr c2 c3 => 1 + (size_co c2) + (size_co c3)
    | co_pair c2 c3 => 1 + (size_co c2) + (size_co c3)
    | co_proj1 => 1
    | co_proj2 => 1
    | co_distArr => 1
    | co_distRcd l1 => 1
    | co_rcd l1 c2 => 1 + (size_co c2)
    | co_topArr => 1
    | co_topRcd l1 => 1
  end.

Fixpoint size_exp (e1 : exp) {struct e1} : nat :=
  match e1 with
    | trm_var_f x1 => 1
    | trm_var_b n1 => 1
    | trm_unit => 1
    | trm_lit i1 => 1
    | trm_abs e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | trm_app e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | trm_pair e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | trm_rcd l1 e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | trm_proj e2 l1 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | trm_capp c1 e2 => 1 + (size_co c1) + (size_exp e2)
  end.

Inductive degree_exp_wrt_exp : nat -> exp -> Prop :=
  | degree_wrt_exp_trm_var_f : forall n1 x1,
    degree_exp_wrt_exp n1 (trm_var_f x1)
  | degree_wrt_exp_trm_var_b : forall n1 n2,
    lt n2 n1 ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp n1 (trm_var_b n2)
  | degree_wrt_exp_trm_unit : forall n1,
    degree_exp_wrt_exp n1 (trm_unit)
  | degree_wrt_exp_trm_lit : forall n1 i1,
    degree_exp_wrt_exp n1 (trm_lit i1)
  | degree_wrt_exp_trm_abs : forall n1 e1,
    degree_exp_wrt_exp (S n1) e1 ->

match A with
    | styp_nat => a_nat
    | styp_arrow A1 A2  => a_arrow (ptyp2styp A1) (ptyp2styp A2)
    | styp_and A1 A2 => a_prod (ptyp2styp A1) (ptyp2styp A2)
    | styp_top => a_unit
    | styp_rcd l A => a_rcd l (ptyp2styp A)
  end.

Inductive sub : styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | S_refl : forall (A:styp),
     sub A A co_id
 | S_trans : forall (A1 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co) (A2:styp),
     sub A2 A3 c1 ->
     sub A1 A2 c2 ->
     sub A1 A3 (co_trans c1 c2)
 | S_top : forall (A:styp),
     sub A styp_top co_top
 | S_topArr :
     sub styp_top (styp_arrow styp_top styp_top) co_topArr
 | S_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     sub styp_top (styp_rcd l styp_top) (co_topRcd l)
 | S_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub B1 A1 c1 ->
     sub A2 B2 c2 ->
     sub (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_arrow B1 B2) (co_arr c1 c2)
 | S_and : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub A1 A2 c1 ->
     sub A1 A3 c2 ->
     sub A1 (styp_and A2 A3) (co_pair c1 c2)
 | S_andl : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A1 co_proj1
 | S_andr : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A2 co_proj2
 | S_distArr : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp),
     sub (styp_and  (styp_arrow A1 A2)   (styp_arrow A1 A3) ) (styp_arrow A1 (styp_and A2 A3)) co_distArr
 | S_rcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp) (c:co),
     sub A B c ->
     sub (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B) (co_rcd l c)
 | S_distRcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp),
     sub (styp_and (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B)) (styp_rcd l (styp_and A B)) (co_distRcd l).

Inductive ASub : ls -> styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | A_nat :
     ASub  nil  styp_nat styp_nat co_id
 | A_rcdNat : forall (l:i) (fs:ls) (A:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A styp_nat c ->
     ASub  (cons (st_la  l )  fs )  (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat (co_rcd l c)
 | A_rcd : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp) (l:i) (B:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_la  l ) nil))  A B c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_rcd l B) c
 | A_top : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp),
     ASub fs A styp_top (co_trans  (calTop  fs )  co_top)
 | A_and : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub fs A B1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A B2 c2 ->
     ASub fs A (styp_and B1 B2) (co_trans  (calAnd  fs )  (co_pair c1 c2))
 | A_arr : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_ty  B1 ) nil))  A B2 c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_arrow B1 B2) c
 | A_andN1 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A1 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj1)
 | A_andN2 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj2)
 | A_arrNat : forall (A:styp) (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub  nil  A A1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c2 ->
     ASub  (cons (st_ty  A )  fs )  (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat (co_arr c1 c2).

Inductive disjoint : styp -> styp -> Prop :=
 | D_topL : forall (A:styp),
     disjoint styp_top A
 | D_topR : forall (A:styp),
     disjoint A styp_top
 | D_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:styp),
     disjoint A2 B2 ->
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_arrow B1 B2)
 | D_andL : forall (A1 A2 B:styp),
     disjoint A1 B ->
     disjoint A2 B ->
     disjoint (styp_and A1 A2) B
 | D_andR : forall (A B1 B2:styp),
     disjoint A B1 ->
     disjoint A B2 ->
     disjoint A (styp_and B1 B2)
 | D_rcdEq : forall (l:i) (A B:styp),
     disjoint A B ->
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B)
 | D_rcdNeq : forall (l1:i) (A:styp) (l2:i) (B:styp),
      l1  <>  l2  ->
     disjoint (styp_rcd l1 A) (styp_rcd l2 B)
 | D_axNatArr : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint styp_nat (styp_arrow A1 A2)
 | D_axArrNat : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat
 | D_axNatRcd : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint styp_nat (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdNat : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat
 | D_axArrRcd : forall (A1 A2:styp) (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdArr : forall (l:i) (A A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) (styp_arrow A1 A2).

Inductive has_type : sctx -> sexp -> dirflag -> styp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | T_top : forall (GG:sctx),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG e_top Inf styp_top trm_unit
 | T_lit : forall (GG:sctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_lit i5) Inf styp_nat (trm_lit i5)
 | T_var : forall (GG:sctx) (x:var) (A:styp),
      uniq  GG  ->
      binds  x A GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_var_f x) Inf A (trm_var_f x)
 | T_app : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp) (A1:styp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Chk A1 e2 ->
     has_type GG (e_app ee1 ee2) Inf A2 (trm_app e1 e2)
 | T_merge : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A1 A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf A1 e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Inf A2 e2 ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     has_type GG (e_merge ee1 ee2) Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (trm_pair e1 e2)
 | T_rcd : forall (GG:sctx) (l:i) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf A e ->
     has_type GG (e_rcd l ee) Inf (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l e)
 | T_proj : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (l:i) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf (styp_rcd l A) e ->
     has_type GG (e_proj ee l) Inf A (trm_proj e l)
 | T_anno : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Chk A e ->
     has_type GG (e_anno ee A) Inf A e
 | T_abs : forall (L:vars) (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A B:styp) (e:exp),

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i := nat.

Inductive co : Set :=
 | co_id : co
 | co_trans (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_top : co
 | co_arr (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_pair (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_proj1 : co
 | co_proj2 : co
 | co_distArr : co
 | co_distRcd (l:i)
 | co_rcd (l:i) (c:co)
 | co_topArr : co
 | co_topRcd (l:i).

Inductive styp : Set :=
 | styp_top : styp
 | styp_nat : styp
 | styp_and (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_arrow (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_rcd (l:i) (A:styp)  .

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | trm_var_b (_:nat)
 | trm_var_f (x:var)
 | trm_unit : exp
 | trm_lit (i5:i)
 | trm_abs (e:exp)
 | trm_app (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | trm_pair (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | trm_rcd (l:i) (e:exp)
 | trm_proj (e:exp) (l:i)
 | trm_capp (c:co) (e:exp)  .

Inductive sexp : Set :=
 | e_var_b (_:nat)
 | e_var_f (x:var)
 | e_top : sexp
 | e_lit (i5:i)
 | e_abs (ee:sexp)
 | e_app (ee1:sexp) (ee2:sexp)
 | e_merge (ee1:sexp) (ee2:sexp)
 | e_anno (ee:sexp) (A:styp)
 | e_rcd (l:i) (ee:sexp)
 | e_proj (ee:sexp) (l:i)  .

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:styp)
 | st_la (l:i).

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | a_nat : typ
 | a_unit : typ
 | a_arrow (T1:typ) (T2:typ)
 | a_prod (T1:typ) (T2:typ)
 | a_rcd (l:i) (T:typ)  .

Inductive cc : Set :=
 | cc_Empty : cc
 | cc_Lam (x:var) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_AppL (cc5:cc) (e:exp)
 | cc_AppR (e:exp) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_PairL (cc5:cc) (e:exp)
 | cc_PairR (e:exp) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Co (c:co) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Rcd (l:i) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Proj (cc5:cc) (l:i).

Definition sctx : Set := list ( atom * styp ).

Inductive dirflag : Set :=
 | Inf : dirflag
 | Chk : dirflag.

Inductive C : Set :=
 | C_Empty : C
 | C_Lam (x:var) (C5:C)
 | C_AppL (C5:C) (ee:sexp)
 | C_AppRd (ee:sexp) (C5:C)
 | C_MergeL (C5:C) (ee:sexp)
 | C_MergeR (ee:sexp) (C5:C)
 | C_Anno (C5:C) (A:styp)
 | C_Rcd (l:i) (C5:C)
 | C_Proj (C5:C) (l:i).

Definition ls : Set := list st.

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => trm_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => trm_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (trm_var_f x) => trm_var_f x
  | trm_unit => trm_unit
  | (trm_lit i5) => trm_lit i5
  | (trm_abs e) => trm_abs (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e)
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (trm_pair e1 e2) => trm_pair (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (trm_rcd l e) => trm_rcd l (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_proj e l) => trm_proj (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e) l
  | (trm_capp c e) => trm_capp c (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e)
end.

Fixpoint open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec (k:nat) (ee_5:sexp) (ee__6:sexp) {struct ee__6}: sexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => ee_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs ee) => e_abs (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
  | (e_app ee1 ee2) => e_app (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (e_merge ee1 ee2) => e_merge (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (e_anno ee A) => e_anno (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee) A
  | (e_rcd l ee) => e_rcd l (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee)
  | (e_proj ee l) => e_proj (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee_5 ee) l
end.

Fixpoint open_cc_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e5:exp) (cc_6:cc) {struct cc_6}: cc :=
  match cc_6 with
  | cc_Empty => cc_Empty
  | (cc_Lam x cc5) => cc_Lam x (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5)
  | (cc_AppL cc5 e) => cc_AppL (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e5 e)
  | (cc_AppR e cc5) => cc_AppR (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e5 e) (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5)
  | (cc_PairL cc5 e) => cc_PairL (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e5 e)
  | (cc_PairR e cc5) => cc_PairR (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e5 e) (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5)
  | (cc_Co c cc5) => cc_Co c (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5)
  | (cc_Rcd l cc5) => cc_Rcd l (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5)
  | (cc_Proj cc5 l) => cc_Proj (open_cc_wrt_exp_rec k e5 cc5) l
end.

Fixpoint open_C_wrt_sexp_rec (k:nat) (ee5:sexp) (C_6:C) {struct C_6}: C :=
  match C_6 with
  | C_Empty => C_Empty
  | (C_Lam x C5) => C_Lam x (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5)
  | (C_AppL C5 ee) => C_AppL (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5) (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 ee)
  | (C_AppRd ee C5) => C_AppRd (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 ee) (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5)
  | (C_MergeL C5 ee) => C_MergeL (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5) (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 ee)
  | (C_MergeR ee C5) => C_MergeR (open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 ee) (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5)
  | (C_Anno C5 A) => C_Anno (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5) A
  | (C_Rcd l C5) => C_Rcd l (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5)
  | (C_Proj C5 l) => C_Proj (open_C_wrt_sexp_rec k ee5 C5) l
end.

Definition open_cc_wrt_exp e5 cc_6 := open_cc_wrt_exp_rec 0 cc_6 e5.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition open_C_wrt_sexp ee5 C_6 := open_C_wrt_sexp_rec 0 C_6 ee5.

Definition open_sexp_wrt_sexp ee_5 ee__6 := open_sexp_wrt_sexp_rec 0 ee__6 ee_5.

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_trm_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_exp (trm_var_f x))
 | lc_trm_unit :
     (lc_exp trm_unit)
 | lc_trm_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_exp (trm_lit i5))
 | lc_trm_abs : forall (e:exp),
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (trm_abs e))
 | lc_trm_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (trm_app e1 e2))
 | lc_trm_pair : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (trm_pair e1 e2))
 | lc_trm_rcd : forall (l:i) (e:exp),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (trm_rcd l e))
 | lc_trm_proj : forall (e:exp) (l:i),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (trm_proj e l))
 | lc_trm_capp : forall (c:co) (e:exp),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (trm_capp c e)).

     (lc_sexp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_top :
     (lc_sexp e_top)
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_sexp (e_lit i5))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (ee:sexp),
      ( forall x , lc_sexp  ( open_sexp_wrt_sexp ee (e_var_f x) )  )  ->

     (lc_sexp ee1) ->
     (lc_sexp ee2) ->
     (lc_sexp (e_app ee1 ee2))

Require Import Observations Infrastructure target_inf.

(* ---------- basic star/value facts copied in (for standalone dev) ---------- *)
Lemma value_no_step : forall v, value v -> forall z, ~ step v z.
Proof.
  intros v Hv. induction Hv; intros z Hs; inversion Hs; subst; eauto.
  all: match goal with H : step ?a ?b, IH : forall z, ~ step ?a z |- False => exact (IH b H) end.
Qed.

Lemma step_det : forall a b, step a b -> forall z, step a z -> b = z.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H; intros z H2; inversion H2; subst;
    try reflexivity; try discriminate; try (f_equal; eauto).
  all: exfalso.
  all: try (multimatch goal with Hs : step ?t ?b |- False =>
         (assert (Hv : value t) by (eauto using value_unit, value_lit, value_abs, value_pair, value_rcd, value_cabs, value_cpair, value_topArr);
          exact (@value_no_step t Hv b Hs)) end).
Qed.

Lemma star_from_value : forall e e', value e -> (step star) e e' -> e' = e.
Proof.
  intros e e' Hv H. induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply value_no_step; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma star_value_det : forall a v, (step star) a v -> value v -> forall w, (step star) a w -> value w -> v = w.
Proof.
  intros a v H. induction H; intros Hv w Hw Hvalw.
  - symmetry. eapply star_from_value; eauto.
  - inversion Hw; subst.
    all: try (exfalso; eapply value_no_step; [exact Hvalw | exact H]).
    all: try (match goal with H1 : step _ ?b0, H2 : ?b0 ->* _ |- _ =>

    all: try (eapply IHstar; eauto).
Qed.

- eapply star_step. apply H. apply IHstar. exact H2. Qed.

Fixpoint lcg (n:nat) (e:exp) : Prop :=

Lemma size_exp_open_rec : forall e k y, size_exp (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k (trm_var_f y) e) = size_exp e.

(* ---------- star linearity from determinism ---------- *)
Lemma star_linear : forall a b, (step star) a b -> forall c, (step star) a c ->
  ((step star) b c) \/ ((step star) c b).
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H; intros c Hc.
  - left; exact Hc.
  - inversion Hc; subst.

    + assert (b0 = b) by (eapply step_det; eauto). subst b0.
      destruct (IHstar c H2) as [X|X]; [left|right]; eapply star_step; [exact H | exact X].
Qed.

Lemma E_star_lr : forall A a a' b b', (step star) a a' -> (step star) b b' -> E A a' b' -> E A a b.
Proof.
  intros A a a' b b' Ha Hb [v1 [v2 [H1 [H2 [W1 [W2 AE1]]]]]].
  destruct (star_linear Ha H1) as [X|X]; destruct (star_linear Hb H2) as [Y|Y].

  - exists v1, b'; repeat split; auto.

  - exists a', v2; repeat split; auto.
    assert (v1 = a') by (eapply star_value_det; eauto using WF_value). subst; auto.
  - exists a', b'; repeat split; auto.
    assert (v1 = a') by (eapply star_value_det; eauto using WF_value).
    assert (v2 = b') by (eapply star_value_det; eauto using WF_value). subst; auto.
Qed.

(* E is monotone under reducing both sides *)
Lemma E_red_lr : forall A a a' b b', (step star) a' a -> (step star) b' b -> E A a b -> E A a' b'.
Proof.
  intros A a a' b b' Ha Hb [v1 [v2 [H1 [H2 [W1 [W2 AE1]]]]]].
  exists v1, v2; repeat split; auto; eapply star_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Definition CohVal (A:styp) (t:exp) : Prop :=
  forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 -> E C (trm_capp c1 t) (trm_capp c2 t).

Lemma Coh_star : forall A t v, (step star) t v -> WF A v -> CohVal A t -> CohVal A v.
Proof.
  intros A t v Ht Wv HC C c1 c2 H1 H2.
  assert (E C (trm_capp c1 t)(trm_capp c2 t)) as HE by (apply HC; auto).
  eapply E_red_lr; [apply star_capp; exact Ht | apply star_capp; exact Ht | exact HE].

    [u1 [u2 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Wu1 [Wu2 AEa]]]]]]
    [v1 [v2 [Hb1 [Hb2 [Wv1 [Wv2 AEb]]]]]] Hb1lc Hb2lc.

Qed.

Lemma value_no_step : forall v, value v -> forall z, ~ step v z.
Proof.
  intros v Hv. induction Hv; intros z Hs; inversion Hs; subst; eauto.
  all: match goal with H : step ?a ?b, IH : forall z, ~ step ?a z |- False => exact (IH b H) end.
Qed.

Lemma step_det : forall a b, step a b -> forall z, step a z -> b = z.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H; intros z H2; inversion H2; subst;
    try reflexivity; try discriminate; try (f_equal; eauto).
  all: exfalso.
  all: try (multimatch goal with Hs : step ?t ?b |- False =>
         (assert (Hv : value t) by (eauto using value_unit, value_lit, value_abs, value_pair, value_rcd, value_cabs, value_cpair, value_topArr);

  - exact (IHe m sigma He Hs).

Lemma close_lcg_gen : forall k t x, lcg k t -> lcg (S k) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k x t).

  E A2 (trm_app f1 g1) (trm_app f2 g2).

    [u1 [u2 [Hf1 [Hf2 [Wu1 [Wu2 AEu]]]]]]

- if two coercions out of `and A B` (with `disjoint A B`) factor through the same component, the induction hypothesis’s component coherence `Coh A a` / `Coh B b` applies;
- if they factor through different components, the common target is reached from both disjoint components, and `TR` on that target gives the required `E`.

The remaining technical gap is exactly that factorization/classification lemma (`sub (and A B) C d` with `disjoint A B` factors through `A`, through `B`, or into a `TR` target), including `S_trans` chains, plus the corresponding record and arrow cases and the `EnvOK`-based open-term layer for the `CTyp` consumer. The trans case is the main remaining difficulty, but the `TR`/`TR_sub` layer now supplies the “trivial target” half of the factorization argument.

  | styp_top => v1 = trm_unit /\ v2 = trm_unit
  | styp_nat => exists k, v1 = trm_lit k /\ v2 = trm_lit k
  | styp_and A1 A2 =>
      disjoint A1 A2 /\
      (exists a1 b1 a2 b2,
        v1 = trm_pair a1 b1 /\ v2 = trm_pair a2 b2 /\
        OV A1 a1 a2 /\ OV A2 b1 b2)
  | styp_rcd l A1 =>
      exists a1 a2, v1 = trm_rcd l a1 /\ v2 = trm_rcd l a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2
  | styp_arrow A1 A2 =>
      lc_exp v1 /\ lc_exp v2 /\ value v1 /\ value v2 /\
      (forall u1 u2,
        (exists a1 a2, (step star) u1 a1 /\ (step star) u2 a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2) ->
        exists w1 w2,
          (step star) (trm_app v1 u1) w1 /\
          (step star) (trm_app v2 u2) w2 /\
          OV A2 w1 w2)
  end.

Definition Rel (A:styp) (t1 t2:exp) : Prop :=
  exists v1 v2, (step star) t1 v1 /\ (step star) t2 v2 /\ OV A v1 v2.

Lemma OV_value_l : forall A v1 v2, OV A v1 v2 -> value v1.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A; intros v1 v2 H; simpl in H.
  - destruct H; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [k [H1 H2]]; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [_ [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [X Y]]]]]]]].
    subst; constructor; [apply IHA1; exact X | apply IHA2; exact Y].
  - destruct H as [a1 [a2 [E1 [E2 X]]]]; subst; constructor.
    apply IHA; exact X.
  - destruct H as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]]; exact val1.
Qed.

Lemma OV_value_r : forall A v1 v2, OV A v1 v2 -> value v2.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A; intros v1 v2 H; simpl in H.
  - destruct H; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [k [H1 H2]]; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [_ [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [X Y]]]]]]]].
    subst; constructor; [apply IHA1; exact X | apply IHA2; exact Y].
  - destruct H as [a1 [a2 [E1 [E2 X]]]]; subst; constructor.
    apply IHA; exact X.
  - destruct H as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]]; exact val2.
Qed.

Lemma Rel_nat_kleene : forall t1 t2, Rel styp_nat t1 t2 -> kleene_equiv t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 H]]]]. simpl in H.
  destruct H as [k [E1 E2]]. subst v1 v2.
  exists k; split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Rel_star_l : forall A t t' u, (step star) t t' -> Rel A t' u -> Rel A t u.
Proof.
  intros A t t' u Ht [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 H]]]].
  exists v1, v2. repeat split; auto.
  eapply star_trans; [exact Ht | exact S1].
Qed.

Lemma Rel_star_r : forall A t u u', (step star) u u' -> Rel A t u' -> Rel A t u.
Proof.
  intros A t u u' Hu [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 H]]]].
  exists v1, v2. repeat split; auto.
  eapply star_trans; [exact Hu | exact S2].
Qed.

Lemma Rel_top : Rel styp_top trm_unit trm_unit.
Proof. exists trm_unit, trm_unit. repeat split; auto; apply star_refl. Qed.

Lemma Rel_nat_lit : forall k, Rel styp_nat (trm_lit k) (trm_lit k).
Proof. intros. exists (trm_lit k), (trm_lit k). repeat split; auto; apply star_refl. Qed.

Lemma Rel_and : forall A B a1 b1 a2 b2,
  disjoint A B -> OV A a1 a2 -> OV B b1 b2 ->
  Rel (styp_and A B) (trm_pair a1 b1) (trm_pair a2 b2).
Proof.
  intros. exists (trm_pair a1 b1), (trm_pair a2 b2). repeat split; auto;
    apply star_refl.
Qed.

Lemma Rel_rcd : forall l A a1 a2, OV A a1 a2 ->
  Rel (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l a1) (trm_rcd l a2).
Proof.
  intros. exists (trm_rcd l a1), (trm_rcd l a2). repeat split; auto;
    apply star_refl.
Qed.

  | ImgJ_refl _ _ _ _ => 0

'''

open('Task.v','w').write(p)
PY

`coherence_thm` remains open. Task.v is at 2508 lines / 143 `Qed`s; all helper content compiles, no escapes.

**Added this round**

- `ImgJ` is now a **computable `Set`-valued inductive** (not `Prop`), and `ImgJ_of_sub` is transparent (`Defined`), so images can be eliminated to data.
- `ImgJ_depth : ImgJ A C a w X v -> nat` and `ImgJ_depth_of_sub` (a `sub`-derivation image has depth exactly 1), the bookkeeping needed for a well-founded induction over coercion-image depth.

**Termination obstruction found for the lexicographic plan**

While setting up the promised `(size_co c, ImgJ-depth)` induction, I found that this particular scheme **does not terminate**:
- the `ImgJ_step` case composes the current coercion with the step’s coercion (`co_trans c c'`), so `size_co` grows while depth decreases;
- the `ImgJ_refl` base case, when the coercion is `co_trans e1 e2`, constructs a depth-1 image for `e2` and recurses on `e1`;
- the subsequent `ImgJ_step` reconstructs `co_trans e1 e2`, returning to the original obligation — an actual loop (`(depth 0, size(co_trans e1 e2)) → (depth 1, size e1) → (depth 0, size(co_trans e1 e2))`).

So a naive lexicographic measure on `(size_co c, ImgJ_depth)` is unsound as a proof strategy. The correct analysis must avoid composing/re-associating coercions at the image level and instead prove a **junk-aware semantic invariant** (values at nat-reachable types are reducible to a literal under every nat coercion, with shape preservation along coercions), or use a normalization argument for the coercion trees.

Everything added so far is verified and compiles; the final nat-intersection coherence, the arrow/record coherence, the fundamental lemma, and the `CTyp` consumer remain unproved, so `coherence_thm` is still not completed.

  simpl in X. destruct X as [[k [E1 E2]] _].

Lemma subst_env_open_rec : forall ee k sigma x0 u,
  x0 \notin fv_exp ee -> (forall y, lcg 0 (sigma y)) ->
  subst_env (extend sigma x0 u) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k (trm_var_f x0) ee)
  = open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k u (subst_env sigma ee).
Proof.
  intros ee. induction ee; intros k sigma x0 u Hfv Hs; simpl in *.
  - (* var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H1|H1]|H1].
    + reflexivity.
    + unfold extend. change ((if x0 == x0 then u else sigma x0) = u).
      destruct (x0 == x0) as [Heq|Hne].
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* var_f x *) unfold extend. change ((if x == x0 then u else sigma x) = open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k u (sigma x)).
    rewrite (@open_rec_lcg (sigma x) 0 (Hs x) k u ltac:(lia)).
    destruct (x == x0) as [Heq|Hne].
    + exfalso; apply Hfv; subst; simpl; fsetdec.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* unit *) reflexivity.
Lemma close_rec_id : forall e k x,
  lcg k e -> x \notin fv_exp e -> close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k x e = e.
Proof.
  intros e. induction e; intros k xx Hlc Hfv; simpl in *; auto.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec n k) as [Hlt|Hge]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
  - destruct (xx == x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + exfalso. apply Hfv. subst xx. simpl. fsetdec.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHe (S k) xx Hlc Hfv). reflexivity.
  - destruct Hlc as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHe1 k xx H1 ltac:(fsetdec)).
    rewrite (IHe2 k xx H2 ltac:(fsetdec)). reflexivity.
  - destruct Hlc as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHe1 k xx H1 ltac:(fsetdec)).
    rewrite (IHe2 k xx H2 ltac:(fsetdec)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHe k xx Hlc ltac:(fsetdec)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHe k xx Hlc ltac:(fsetdec)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHe k xx Hlc ltac:(fsetdec)). reflexivity.
Qed.

  exists k, t1 ->* (trm_lit k) /\ t2 ->* (trm_lit k).

  match ctx with

  | cc_Rcd l c => trm_rcd l (appctx c t)
  | cc_Proj c l => trm_proj (appctx c t) l
  end.

with AE (A:styp) : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
  match A with
  | styp_top => fun v1 v2 => v1 = trm_unit /\ v2 = trm_unit
  | styp_nat => fun v1 v2 => exists k, v1 = trm_lit k /\ v2 = trm_lit k
  | styp_and A1 A2 => fun v1 v2 => exists a1 b1 a2 b2,
        v1 = trm_pair a1 b1 /\ v2 = trm_pair a2 b2 /\ AE A1 a1 a2 /\ AE A2 b1 b2
  | styp_rcd l A1 => fun v1 v2 => exists a1 a2, v1 = trm_rcd l a1 /\ v2 = trm_rcd l a2 /\ AE A1 a1 a2
  | styp_arrow A1 A2 => fun v1 v2 =>
      lc_exp v1 /\ lc_exp v2 /\ value v1 /\ value v2 /\
      (forall u1 u2, WF A1 u1 -> WF A1 u2 -> AE A1 u1 u2 ->
         exists w1 w2, (step star) (trm_app v1 u1) w1 /\ (step star) (trm_app v2 u2) w2 /\
                       WF A2 w1 /\ WF A2 w2 /\ AE A2 w1 w2)
  end.

Definition V (A:styp) (v1 v2:exp) : Prop := WF A v1 /\ WF A v2 /\ AE A v1 v2.
Definition E (A:styp) (e1 e2:exp) : Prop :=

Lemma WF_value : forall A v, WF A v -> value v.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A; intros v H; simpl in H.
  - subst; apply value_unit.
  - destruct H as [k Hk]; subst; apply value_lit.
  - destruct H as [a [b [He [Ha Hb]]]]; subst; apply value_pair; auto.
  - destruct H as [Hlc [Hv _]]; exact Hv.
  - destruct H as [a [He Ha]]; subst; apply value_rcd; auto.
Qed.

  forall x A, binds x A Γ -> E A (σ x) (σ x).

  destruct (HE x A Hb) as [W HC].

  - apply E_WF_self. exact W.
  - exact HC.
  - exact Hs.

  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [[Hxy HAB]|Htail].
  - subst y B. unfold extend.

  - unfold extend.

  - exact H.

  | NR_andl : forall A B, NatReach A -> NatReach (styp_and A B)
  | NR_andr : forall A B, NatReach B -> NatReach (styp_and A B).

Lemma NatReach_sub : forall A B c, sub A B c -> NatReach B -> NatReach A.
Proof.
  intros A B c Hsub. induction Hsub; intros h;
    try (inversion h; subst); eauto using NR_andl, NR_andr.
Qed.

Lemma sub_nat_reach : forall A c, sub A styp_nat c -> NatReach A.
Proof. intros. apply (@NatReach_sub A styp_nat c H). constructor. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_NatReach : forall A B, disjoint A B -> NatReach A -> NatReach B -> False.
Proof.
  intros A B D. induction D; intros hA hB;
    try (inversion hA; subst); try (inversion hB; subst); eauto.
Qed.
Lemma sub_nat_nat_star : forall c, sub styp_nat styp_nat c ->
  forall k, (step star) (trm_capp c (trm_lit k)) (trm_lit k).
Proof.
  intros c Hs k.
  pose proof (comp_cn styp_nat styp_nat c Hs k) as HE.
  change (E styp_nat (trm_capp c (trm_lit k)) (trm_lit k)) in HE.
  destruct HE as [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 [W1 [W2 AE]]]]]].
  assert (v2 = trm_lit k) by
    (exact (@star_from_value (trm_lit k) v2 (value_lit k) S2)).
  subst v2.
  simpl in AE. destruct AE as [j [E1 E2]].
  assert (j = k) by congruence. subst j. subst v1.
  exact S1.
Qed.

Lemma OV_nat_coerce : forall v1 v2, OV styp_nat v1 v2 ->
  forall c1 c2, sub styp_nat styp_nat c1 -> sub styp_nat styp_nat c2 ->
  Rel styp_nat (trm_capp c1 v1) (trm_capp c2 v2).
Proof.
  intros v1 v2 H c1 c2 H1 H2.
  destruct H as [k [E1 E2]]. subst v1 v2.
  exists (trm_lit k), (trm_lit k).
  split.
  - apply sub_nat_nat_star; assumption.
  - split.
    + apply sub_nat_nat_star; assumption.
    + simpl. exists k; split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma NatReach_not_rcd : forall l A, NatReach (styp_rcd l A) -> False.

Lemma Coh_star : forall A t v, (step star) t v -> WF A v -> CohVal A t -> CohVal A v.
Proof.
  intros A t v Ht Wv HC C c1 c2 H1 H2.
  assert (E C (trm_capp c1 t)(trm_capp c2 t)) as HE by (apply HC; auto).
  apply E_red_r with (b := trm_capp c2 t). apply star_capp; exact Ht.
  apply E_red_l with (a := trm_capp c1 t). apply star_capp; exact Ht. exact HE.
Qed.

Lemma Coh_coerce : forall A B t c, E A t t -> CohVal A t -> sub A B c -> CohVal B (trm_capp c t).
Proof.
  intros A B t c HE HC Hs C d1 d2 Hd1 Hd2.
  assert (HEc : E C (trm_capp (co_trans d1 c) t)(trm_capp (co_trans d2 c) t))
    by (apply HC; [eapply S_trans with (A2:=B); eauto | eapply S_trans with (A2:=B); eauto]).
  destruct (@E_WF_l A t t HE) as [v [Ht Wv]].
  pose (P1 := trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c v)).
  pose (P2 := trm_capp d2 (trm_capp c v)).
  assert (HL1 : (step star) (trm_capp (co_trans d1 c) t) P1).
  { unfold P1. eapply star_trans.
    - apply star_capp; exact Ht.
    - eapply star_step; [apply step_trans; eapply WF_value; eauto | apply star_refl]. }
  assert (HL2 : (step star) (trm_capp (co_trans d2 c) t) P2).
  { unfold P2. eapply star_trans.
    - apply star_capp; exact Ht.
    - eapply star_step; [apply step_trans; eapply WF_value; eauto | apply star_refl]. }
  assert (HM1 : (step star) (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t)) P1).
  { unfold P1. apply star_capp. apply star_capp. exact Ht. }
  assert (HM2 : (step star) (trm_capp d2 (trm_capp c t)) P2).
  { unfold P2. apply star_capp. apply star_capp. exact Ht. }
  assert (X : E C P1 (trm_capp (co_trans d2 c) t)) by (exact (@E_red_l C (trm_capp (co_trans d1 c) t) P1 (trm_capp (co_trans d2 c) t) HL1 HEc)).
  assert (Y : E C P1 P2) by (exact (@E_red_r C P1 (trm_capp (co_trans d2 c) t) P2 HL2 X)).
  assert (Z : E C (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t)) P2)
    by (exact (@E_star_lr C (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t)) P1 P2 P2 HM1 (star_refl step P2) Y)).
  exact (@E_star_lr C (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t)) (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t)) (trm_capp d2 (trm_capp c t)) P2 (star_refl step (trm_capp d1 (trm_capp c t))) HM2 Z).
Qed.

| styp_top => v1 = trm_unit /\ v2 = trm_unit
  | styp_nat => exists k, v1 = trm_lit k /\ v2 = trm_lit k
  | styp_and A1 A2 =>
      disjoint A1 A2 /\
      (exists a1 b1 a2 b2,
        v1 = trm_pair a1 b1 /\ v2 = trm_pair a2 b2 /\
        OV A1 a1 a2 /\ OV A2 b1 b2)
  | styp_rcd l A1 =>
      exists a1 a2, v1 = trm_rcd l a1 /\ v2 = trm_rcd l a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2
  | styp_arrow A1 A2 =>
      lc_exp v1 /\ lc_exp v2 /\ value v1 /\ value v2 /\
      (forall u1 u2,
        (exists a1 a2, (step star) u1 a1 /\ (step star) u2 a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2) ->
        exists w1 w2,
          (step star) (trm_app v1 u1) w1 /\
          (step star) (trm_app v2 u2) w2 /\
          OV A2 w1 w2)
  end.

Definition Rel (A:styp) (t1 t2:exp) : Prop :=
  exists v1 v2, (step star) t1 v1 /\ (step star) t2 v2 /\ OV A v1 v2.

Lemma OV_value_l : forall A v1 v2, OV A v1 v2 -> value v1.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A; intros v1 v2 H; simpl in H.
  - destruct H; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [k [H1 H2]]; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [_ [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [X Y]]]]]]]].
    subst; apply value_pair; [exact (IHA1 a1 a2 X) | exact (IHA2 b1 b2 Y)].
  - destruct H as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]]; exact val1.
  - destruct H as [a1 [a2 [E1 [E2 X]]]]; subst; apply value_rcd.
    exact (IHA a1 a2 X).
Qed.

Lemma OV_value_r : forall A v1 v2, OV A v1 v2 -> value v2.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A; intros v1 v2 H; simpl in H.
  - destruct H; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [k [H1 H2]]; subst; constructor.
  - destruct H as [_ [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [X Y]]]]]]]].
    subst; apply value_pair; [exact (IHA1 a1 a2 X) | exact (IHA2 b1 b2 Y)].
  - destruct H as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]]; exact val2.
  - destruct H as [a1 [a2 [E1 [E2 X]]]]; subst; apply value_rcd.
    exact (IHA a1 a2 X).
Qed.

Lemma Rel_nat_kleene : forall t1 t2, Rel styp_nat t1 t2 -> kleene_equiv t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 H]]]]. simpl in H.
  destruct H as [k [E1 E2]]. subst v1 v2.
  exists k; split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Rel_star_l : forall A t t' u, (step star) t t' -> Rel A t' u -> Rel A t u.
Proof.
  intros A t t' u Ht [v1 [v2 [S1 [S2 H]]]].
  exists v1, v2. repeat split; auto.
  eapply star_trans; [exact Ht | exact S1].
Qed.

Lemma Rel_star_r : forall A t u u', (step star) u u' -> Rel A t u' -> Rel A t u.
  intros. exists (trm_lit k), (trm_lit k).
  split; [apply star_refl | split; [apply star_refl | simpl; exists k; split; reflexivity]].
Qed.

Lemma Rel_and : forall A B a1 b1 a2 b2,
  disjoint A B -> OV A a1 a2 -> OV B b1 b2 ->
  Rel (styp_and A B) (trm_pair a1 b1) (trm_pair a2 b2).
Proof.
  intros A B a1 b1 a2 b2 HD X Y.
  exists (trm_pair a1 b1), (trm_pair a2 b2).
  split; [apply star_refl | split; [apply star_refl |]].
  simpl. split; [exact HD |].
  exists a1, b1, a2, b2. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Rel_rcd : forall l A a1 a2, OV A a1 a2 ->
  Rel (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l a1) (trm_rcd l a2).
Proof.
  intros l A a1 a2 X.
  exists (trm_rcd l a1), (trm_rcd l a2).
  split; [apply star_refl | split; [apply star_refl |]].
  simpl. exists a1, a2. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma OV_sym : forall A v1 v2, OV A v1 v2 -> OV A v2 v1.
Proof.
  - destruct H as [HD [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [X Y]]]]]]]].
    subst; apply lc_trm_pair; [exact (IHA1 a1 a2 X) | exact (IHA2 b1 b2 Y)].
  - destruct H as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]]; exact lc2.
  - destruct H as [a1 [a2 [E1 [E2 X]]]]; subst; apply lc_trm_rcd.
    exact (IHA a1 a2 X).
Qed.

Lemma Rel_app : forall A1 A2 f1 f2 g1 g2,
  Rel (styp_arrow A1 A2) f1 f2 ->
  Rel A1 g1 g2 -> lc_exp g1 -> lc_exp g2 ->
  Rel A2 (trm_app f1 g1) (trm_app f2 g2).
Proof.
  intros A1 A2 f1 f2 g1 g2
    [vf1 [vf2 [Sf1 [Sf2 VF]]]]
    [vg1 [vg2 [Sg1 [Sg2 VG]]]] Hg1lc Hg2lc.
  simpl in VF. destruct VF as [lcf1 [lcf2 [valf1 [valf2 app]]]].
  assert (Hrel : exists a1 a2 : exp, (step star) g1 a1 /\ (step star) g2 a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2)
    by (exists vg1, vg2; repeat split; auto).
  destruct (app g1 g2 Hrel) as [w1 [w2 [T1 [T2 OW]]]].
  exists w1, w2.
  split.
  - eapply star_trans.
    + apply star_app_l; [exact Sf1 | exact Hg1lc].
    + exact T1.
  - split.
    + eapply star_trans.
      * apply star_app_l; [exact Sf2 | exact Hg2lc].
      * exact T2.
    + exact OW.

  Rel (styp_arrow A1 A2) f1 f2 ->

  Rel A2 (trm_app f1 g1) (trm_app f2 g2).
Proof.
  intros A1 A2 f1 f2 g1 g2
    [vf1 [vf2 [Sf1 [Sf2 VF]]]]
    [vg1 [vg2 [Sg1 [Sg2 VG]]]] Hg1lc Hg2lc.
  simpl in VF. destruct VF as [lcf1 [lcf2 [valf1 [valf2 app]]]].
  assert (Hrel : exists a1 a2 : exp, (step star) g1 a1 /\ (step star) g2 a2 /\ OV A1 a1 a2)
    by (exists vg1, vg2; repeat split; auto).
  destruct (app g1 g2 Hrel) as [w1 [w2 [T1 [T2 OW]]]].
  exists w1, w2.
  split.
  - eapply star_trans.
    + apply star_app_l; [exact Sf1 | exact Hg1lc].
    + exact T1.
  - split.
    + eapply star_trans.
      * apply star_app_l; [exact Sf2 | exact Hg2lc].
      * exact T2.
    + exact OW.
Qed.

Lemma E_to_AE : forall A v1 v2, WF A v1 -> WF A v2 -> E A v1 v2 -> AE A v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros A v1 v2 W1 W2 [u1 [u2 [S1 [S2 [Wu1 [Wu2 AE]]]]]].
  assert (u1 = v1) by
    (eapply star_value_det; [exact S1 | exact (@WF_value A u1 Wu1) | apply star_refl | exact (@WF_value A v1 W1)]).
  assert (u2 = v2) by
    (eapply star_value_det; [exact S2 | exact (@WF_value A u2 Wu2) | apply star_refl | exact (@WF_value A v2 W2)]).
  subst u1 u2. exact AE.
Qed.

Definition TR (A:styp) : Prop :=
  forall v1 v2, WF A v1 -> WF A v2 -> E A v1 v2.

Lemma TR_top : TR styp_top.
Proof.
  intros v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2. subst v1 v2.
  apply E_WF_self. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma TR_and : forall A B, TR A -> TR B -> TR (styp_and A B).
Proof.
  intros A B HA HB v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2.
  destruct W1 as [a1 [b1 [E1 [Wa1 Wb1]]]].
  destruct W2 as [a2 [b2 [E2 [Wa2 Wb2]]]].
  subst v1 v2. apply E_pair.
  - apply HA; assumption.
  - apply HB; assumption.
  - exact (@WF_lc B b1 Wb1).
  - exact (@WF_lc B b2 Wb2).
Qed.

Lemma TR_rcd : forall l A, TR A -> TR (styp_rcd l A).
Proof.
  intros l A HA v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2.
  destruct W1 as [a1 [E1 Wa1]]. destruct W2 as [a2 [E2 Wa2]].
  subst v1 v2. apply E_rcd. apply HA; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma TR_arrow : forall A B, TR B -> TR (styp_arrow A B).

Proof.

  { apply lc_trm_abs. intros y.

Definition TR (A:styp) : Prop :=
  forall v1 v2, WF A v1 -> WF A v2 -> E A v1 v2.

Lemma TR_top : TR styp_top.
Proof.
  intros v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2. subst v1 v2.
  apply E_WF_self. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma TR_and : forall A B, TR A -> TR B -> TR (styp_and A B).
Proof.
  intros A B HA HB v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2.
  destruct W1 as [a1 [b1 [E1 [Wa1 Wb1]]]].
  destruct W2 as [a2 [b2 [E2 [Wa2 Wb2]]]].
  subst v1 v2. apply E_pair.
  - apply HA; assumption.
  - apply HB; assumption.
  - exact (@WF_lc B b1 Wb1).
  - exact (@WF_lc B b2 Wb2).
Qed.

Lemma TR_rcd : forall l A, TR A -> TR (styp_rcd l A).
Proof.
  intros l A HA v1 v2 W1 W2. simpl in W1, W2.
  destruct W1 as [a1 [E1 Wa1]]. destruct W2 as [a2 [E2 Wa2]].
  subst v1 v2. apply E_rcd. apply HA; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma TR_arrow : forall A B, TR B -> TR (styp_arrow A B).
Proof.
  intros A B HB v1 v2 W1 W2.
  destruct W1 as [lc1 [val1 app1]]. destruct W2 as [lc2 [val2 app2]].
  assert (WF1 : WF (styp_arrow A B) v1) by
    (split; [exact lc1 | split; [exact val1 | exact app1]]).
  assert (WF2 : WF (styp_arrow A B) v2) by
    (split; [exact lc2 | split; [exact val2 | exact app2]]).
  exists v1, v2.
  split.
  { apply star_refl. }
  split.
  { apply star_refl. }
  split.
  { exact WF1. }
  split.
  { exact WF2. }
  split.
  - exact lc1.
  - split.
    + exact lc2.
    + split.
      * exact val1.
      * split.
        -- exact val2.
        -- intros u1 u2 Wu1 Wu2 Au.
           destruct (app1 u1 u2 Wu1 Wu2 Au) as [w1 [w2 [S1 [S2 [Ww1 [Ww2 AEw]]]]]].
           destruct (app2 u1 u2 Wu1 Wu2 Au) as [x1 [x2 [T1 [T2 [Wx1 [Wx2 AEx]]]]]].
           exists w1, x2.

           ++ exact S1.

              ** exact T2.

                 { exact Ww1. }

  WF B w -> value u -> (step star) (trm_app (trm_abs w) u) w.
Proof.
  intros B w u Ww Hu.
  assert (Lw : lc_exp w) by (exact (@WF_lc B w Ww)).
  assert (Lab : lc_exp (trm_abs w)).
  { apply lc_trm_abs. intros y.
    unfold open_exp_wrt_exp.
    rewrite (@open_rec_lcg w 0 (lc_lcg w Lw) 0 (trm_var_f y) ltac:(lia)). exact Lw. }

Proof.

Lemma TR_and_l : forall A B, TR (styp_and A B) -> TR A.
Proof.
  intros A B HTR v1 v2 W1 W2.
  set (ub := CN B 0).
  assert (Wub : WF B ub) by (unfold ub; apply CN_WF).
  assert (Wp1 : WF (styp_and A B) (trm_pair v1 ub)).
  { simpl. exists v1, ub. repeat split; auto. }
  assert (Wp2 : WF (styp_and A B) (trm_pair v2 ub)).
  { simpl. exists v2, ub. repeat split; auto. }
  pose proof (@E_to_AE (styp_and A B) (trm_pair v1 ub) (trm_pair v2 ub)
                Wp1 Wp2 (HTR (trm_pair v1 ub) (trm_pair v2 ub) Wp1 Wp2)) as AEp.
  simpl in AEp.
  destruct AEp as [a1 [b1 [a2 [b2 [E1 [E2 [A1 A2]]]]]]].
  injection E1 as H1 H2. injection E2 as H3 H4.
  subst a1 b1 a2 b2.
  apply (@E_V A v1 v2 W1 W2 A1).

Proof.

  assert (Wp2 : WF (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l v2)).

                Wp1 Wp2 (HTR (trm_rcd l v1) (trm_rcd l v2) Wp1 Wp2)) as AEp.

Lemma TR_arrow_cod : forall A B, TR (styp_arrow A B) -> TR B.
Proof.
  intros A B HTR w1 w2 W1 W2.
  assert (WF1 : WF (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs w1)) by (apply const_WF; exact W1).
  assert (WF2 : WF (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs w2)) by (apply const_WF; exact W2).

                WF1 WF2 (HTR (trm_abs w1) (trm_abs w2) WF1 WF2)) as AEp.
  destruct AEp as [lc1 [lc2 [val1 [val2 app]]]].
  destruct (app (CN A 0) (CN A 0) (CN_WF A 0) (CN_WF A 0)
              (AE_refl A (CN A 0) (CN_WF A 0)))
    as [x1 [x2 [T1 [T2 [Wx1 [Wx2 AEx]]]]]].

    (eapply star_value_det; [exact T1 | exact (@WF_value B x1 Wx1)
      | apply (@const_app_star B w1 (CN A 0) W1 (@WF_value A (CN A 0) (CN_WF A 0)))

  assert (Hx2 : x2 = w2) by

      | apply (@const_app_star B w2 (CN A 0) W2 (@WF_value A (CN A 0) (CN_WF A 0)))
      | exact (@WF_value B w2 W2)]).
  subst x1 x2.
  apply (@E_V B w1 w2 W1 W2 AEx).

  intros Γ E0 dir A e Hty.
  pose proof (has_type_uniq Γ E0 dir A e Hty) as HuniqΓ.
  pose proof (has_type_lc Γ E0 dir A e Hty) as HlcE.
  induction Hty; intros σ1 σ2 Henv.
  - simpl. apply E_WF_self. simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. apply E_WF_self. simpl. exists i. reflexivity.
  - simpl. apply E_V.
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (EnvVE_rel Γ σ1 σ2 x A Henv H))).
    + exact (proj1 (proj2 (EnvVE_rel Γ σ1 σ2 x A Henv H))).
    + exact (proj2 (proj2 (EnvVE_rel Γ σ1 σ2 x A Henv H))).
  - simpl. eapply E_app.
    + apply IHhas_type1. exact Henv.
    + apply IHhas_type2. exact Henv.
    + apply subst_env_lc; [apply has_type_lc in H0; exact H0 | intro x; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 x Henv))].
    + apply subst_env_lc; [apply has_type_lc in H0; exact H0 | intro x; exact (proj2 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 x Henv))].
  - simpl. eapply E_pair.
    + apply IHhas_type1. exact Henv.
    + apply IHhas_type2. exact Henv.
    + apply subst_env_lc; [apply has_type_lc in H0; exact H0 | intro x; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 x Henv))].
    + apply subst_env_lc; [apply has_type_lc in H0; exact H0 | intro x; exact (proj2 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 x Henv))].
  - simpl. apply E_rcd. apply IHhas_type. exact Henv.
  - simpl. apply E_proj. apply IHhas_type. exact Henv.
  - simpl. apply IHhas_type. exact Henv.
  - (* T_abs *)
    simpl.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom Γ \u fv_exp e)) as [x0 Hx0].
    assert (HxL : x0 \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxdom : x0 \notin dom Γ) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxvf : x0 \notin fv_exp e) by fsetdec.
    assert (Huniq : uniq ((x0~A)++Γ)).
    { apply uniq_push; [exact HuniqΓ|exact Hxdom]. }
    assert (Hlc1 : lc_exp (trm_abs (subst_env σ1 e))).
    { apply subst_env_lc; [exact HlcE|intro y; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv))]. }
    assert (Hlc2 : lc_exp (trm_abs (subst_env σ2 e))).

    assert (WF1 : WF (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs (subst_env σ1 e))).
    { split.
      - exact Hlc1.
      - split.
        + apply value_abs. exact Hlc1.
        + intros u1 u2 Wu1 Wu2 Au.
          pose (σu1 := extend σ1 x0 u1).
          pose (σu2 := extend σ1 x0 u2).
          assert (HenvU : EnvVE ((x0~A)++Γ) σu1 σu2).
          { apply EnvVE_extend; [exact Henv|exact Huniq|].
            exact (conj Wu1 (conj Wu2 Au)). }
          specialize (H0 x0 HxL σu1 σu2 HenvU).
          rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ1 x0 u1 Hxvf
                    ltac:(intro y; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
          rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ1 x0 u2 Hxvf
                    ltac:(intro y; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
          destruct H0 as [w1 [w2 [S1 [S2 [Ww1 [Ww2 AEw]]]]]].
          exists w1, w2. split; [|split].
          -- eapply star_trans.
             ++ apply star1. apply step_beta.
                ** exact Hlc1.
                ** apply WF_value. exact Wu1.
             ++ exact S1.
          -- eapply star_trans.
             ++ apply star1. apply step_beta.
                ** exact Hlc1.
                ** apply WF_value. exact Wu2.
             ++ exact S2.
          -- exact Ww1.
          -- exact Ww2.
          -- exact AEw. }
    assert (WF2 : WF (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs (subst_env σ2 e))).
    { split.
      - exact Hlc2.
      - split.
        + apply value_abs. exact Hlc2.
        + intros u1 u2 Wu1 Wu2 Au.
          pose (σu1 := extend σ2 x0 u1).
          pose (σu2 := extend σ2 x0 u2).
          assert (HenvU : EnvVE ((x0~A)++Γ) σu1 σu2).
          { apply EnvVE_extend; [exact Henv|exact Huniq|].
            exact (conj Wu1 (conj Wu2 Au)). }
          specialize (H0 x0 HxL σu1 σu2 HenvU).
          rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ2 x0 u1 Hxvf
                    ltac:(intro y; exact (proj2 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
          rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ2 x0 u2 Hxvf
                    ltac:(intro y; exact (proj2 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
          destruct H0 as [w1 [w2 [S1 [S2 [Ww1 [Ww2 AEw]]]]]].

             ++ apply star1. apply step_beta.
                ** exact Hlc2.
                ** apply WF_value. exact Wu1.
             ++ exact S1.

             ++ apply star1. apply step_beta.
                ** exact Hlc2.
                ** apply WF_value. exact Wu2.
             ++ exact S2.
          -- exact Ww1.
          -- exact Ww2.
          -- exact AEw. }
    assert (AE12 : AE (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs (subst_env σ1 e)) (trm_abs (subst_env σ2 e))).
    { repeat split; [exact Hlc1|exact Hlc2|apply value_abs; exact Hlc1|apply value_abs; exact Hlc2|].

      pose (σu2 := extend σ2 x0 u2).
      assert (HenvU : EnvVE ((x0~A)++Γ) σu1 σu2).
      { apply EnvVE_extend; [exact Henv|exact Huniq|].
        exact (conj Wu1 (conj Wu2 Au)). }
      specialize (H0 x0 HxL σu1 σu2 HenvU).
      rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ1 x0 u1 Hxvf
                ltac:(intro y; exact (proj1 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_env_open_val e σ2 x0 u2 Hxvf
                ltac:(intro y; exact (proj2 (EnvVE_lc Γ σ1 σ2 y Henv)))) in H0.
      destruct H0 as [w1 [w2 [S1 [S2 [Ww1 [Ww2 AEw]]]]]].
      exists w1, w2. split; [|split].
      - eapply star_trans.
        + apply star1. apply step_beta.
          * exact Hlc1.
          * apply WF_value. exact Wu1.
        + exact S1.
      - eapply star_trans.
        + apply star1. apply step_beta.
          * exact Hlc2.
          * apply WF_value. exact Wu2.
        + exact S2.
      - exact Ww1.
      - exact Ww2.
      - exact AEw. }
    apply (@E_V (styp_arrow A B)
             (trm_abs (subst_env σ1 e)) (trm_abs (subst_env σ2 e))).
    repeat split; assumption.
  - (* T_sub *)
    simpl. apply (@capp_E B A c (subst_env σ1 e) (subst_env σ2 e) H).
    apply IHhas_type. exact Henv.
Qed.

Lemma subst_env_congr_fv : forall e sigma sigma',
  (forall y, y \in fv_exp e -> sigma y = sigma' y) ->
  subst_env sigma e = subst_env sigma' e.

  - f_equal. apply IHe. exact H.
  - f_equal. apply IHe. exact H.

Lemma subst_env_single_free : forall e x u,
  (forall y, y \in fv_exp e -> y = x) ->
  subst_env (extend (fun _ => trm_unit) x u) e =
  subst_env (fun z => if z == x then u else trm_var_f z) e.
Proof.
  intros e x u H.
  apply subst_env_congr_fv. intros y Hy.
  unfold extend. destruct (y == x) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|].

CoInductive SR (A:styp) (t1 t2:exp) : Prop :=
| SR_top :
    (step star) t1 trm_unit ->
    (step star) t2 trm_unit ->
    (forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 ->
       SR C (trm_capp c1 t1) (trm_capp c2 t2)) ->
    SR A t1 t2
| SR_nat : forall k,
    (step star) t1 (trm_lit k) ->
    (step star) t2 (trm_lit k) ->
    (forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 ->
       SR C (trm_capp c1 t1) (trm_capp c2 t2)) ->
    SR A t1 t2
| SR_and : forall A1 A2 a1 b1 a2 b2,
    (step star) t1 (trm_pair a1 b1) ->
    (step star) t2 (trm_pair a2 b2) ->
    SR A1 a1 a2 -> SR A2 b1 b2 ->
    (forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 ->
       SR C (trm_capp c1 t1) (trm_capp c2 t2)) ->
    SR A t1 t2
| SR_rcd : forall l A1 a1 a2,
    (step star) t1 (trm_rcd l a1) ->
    (step star) t2 (trm_rcd l a2) ->
    SR A1 a1 a2 ->
    (forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 ->
       SR C (trm_capp c1 t1) (trm_capp c2 t2)) ->
    SR A t1 t2
| SR_arrow : forall A1 A2,
    (forall u1 u2, EK nil A1 u1 u2 ->
       exists w1 w2,
         (step star) (trm_app t1 u1) w1 /\
         (step star) (trm_app t2 u2) w2 /\
         SR A2 w1 w2) ->
    (forall C c1 c2, sub A C c1 -> sub A C c2 ->
       SR C (trm_capp c1 t1) (trm_capp c2 t2)) ->
    SR A t1 t2.

CoFixpoint SR_star_l (A:styp) (t t' u:exp)
  (Hred: (step star) t t') (H: SR A t' u) : SR A t u :=
  match H with
  | SR_top _ _ _ S1 S2 Coh =>
      SR_top A t u

    + apply IHe1. intros y Hy. apply H. fsetdec.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i := nat.

Inductive co : Set :=
 | co_id : co
 | co_trans (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_top : co
 | co_arr (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_pair (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_proj1 : co
 | co_proj2 : co
 | co_distArr : co
 | co_distRcd (l:i)
 | co_rcd (l:i) (c:co)
 | co_topArr : co
 | co_topRcd (l:i).

Inductive styp : Set :=
 | styp_top : styp
 | styp_nat : styp
 | styp_and (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_arrow (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_rcd (l:i) (A:styp)  .

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | trm_var_b (_:nat)
 | trm_var_f (x:var)
 | trm_unit : exp
 | trm_lit (i5:i)
 | trm_abs (e:exp)
 | trm_app (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | trm_pair (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | trm_rcd (l:i) (e:exp)
 | trm_proj (e:exp) (l:i)
 | trm_capp (c:co) (e:exp)  .

Inductive sexp : Set :=
 | e_var_b (_:nat)
 | e_var_f (x:var)
 | e_top : sexp
 | e_lit (i5:i)
 | e_abs (ee:sexp)
 | e_app (ee1:sexp) (ee2:sexp)
 | e_merge (ee1:sexp) (ee2:sexp)
 | e_anno (ee:sexp) (A:styp)
 | e_rcd (l:i) (ee:sexp)
 | e_proj (ee:sexp) (l:i)  .

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:styp)
 | st_la (l:i).

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | a_nat : typ
 | a_unit : typ
 | a_arrow (T1:typ) (T2:typ)
 | a_prod (T1:typ) (T2:typ)
 | a_rcd (l:i) (T:typ)  .

Inductive cc : Set :=
 | cc_Empty : cc
 | cc_Lam (x:var) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_AppL (cc5:cc) (e:exp)
 | cc_AppR (e:exp) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_PairL (cc5:cc) (e:exp)
 | cc_PairR (e:exp) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Co (c:co) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Rcd (l:i) (cc5:cc)
 | cc_Proj (cc5:cc) (l:i).

Definition sctx : Set := list ( atom * styp ).

Inductive dirflag : Set :=
 | Inf : dirflag
 | Chk : dirflag.

Inductive C : Set :=
 | C_Empty : C
 | C_Lam (x:var) (C5:C)
  match A with
    | styp_nat => a_nat
    | styp_arrow A1 A2  => a_arrow (ptyp2styp A1) (ptyp2styp A2)
    | styp_and A1 A2 => a_prod (ptyp2styp A1) (ptyp2styp A2)
    | styp_top => a_unit
    | styp_rcd l A => a_rcd l (ptyp2styp A)
  end.

Inductive sub : styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | S_refl : forall (A:styp),
     sub A A co_id
 | S_trans : forall (A1 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co) (A2:styp),
     sub A2 A3 c1 ->
     sub A1 A2 c2 ->
     sub A1 A3 (co_trans c1 c2)
 | S_top : forall (A:styp),
     sub A styp_top co_top
 | S_topArr :
     sub styp_top (styp_arrow styp_top styp_top) co_topArr
 | S_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     sub styp_top (styp_rcd l styp_top) (co_topRcd l)
 | S_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub B1 A1 c1 ->
     sub A2 B2 c2 ->
     sub (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_arrow B1 B2) (co_arr c1 c2)
 | S_and : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub A1 A2 c1 ->
     sub A1 A3 c2 ->
     sub A1 (styp_and A2 A3) (co_pair c1 c2)
 | S_andl : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A1 co_proj1
 | S_andr : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A2 co_proj2
 | S_distArr : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp),
     sub (styp_and  (styp_arrow A1 A2)   (styp_arrow A1 A3) ) (styp_arrow A1 (styp_and A2 A3)) co_distArr
 | S_rcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp) (c:co),
     sub A B c ->
     sub (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B) (co_rcd l c)
 | S_distRcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp),
     sub (styp_and (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B)) (styp_rcd l (styp_and A B)) (co_distRcd l).

Inductive ASub : ls -> styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | A_nat :
     ASub  nil  styp_nat styp_nat co_id
 | A_rcdNat : forall (l:i) (fs:ls) (A:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A styp_nat c ->
     ASub  (cons (st_la  l )  fs )  (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat (co_rcd l c)
 | A_rcd : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp) (l:i) (B:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_la  l ) nil))  A B c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_rcd l B) c
 | A_top : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp),
     ASub fs A styp_top (co_trans  (calTop  fs )  co_top)
 | A_and : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub fs A B1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A B2 c2 ->
     ASub fs A (styp_and B1 B2) (co_trans  (calAnd  fs )  (co_pair c1 c2))
 | A_arr : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_ty  B1 ) nil))  A B2 c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_arrow B1 B2) c
 | A_andN1 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A1 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj1)
 | A_andN2 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj2)
 | A_arrNat : forall (A:styp) (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub  nil  A A1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c2 ->
     ASub  (cons (st_ty  A )  fs )  (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat (co_arr c1 c2).

Inductive disjoint : styp -> styp -> Prop :=
 | D_topL : forall (A:styp),
     disjoint styp_top A
 | D_topR : forall (A:styp),
     disjoint A styp_top
 | D_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:styp),
     disjoint A2 B2 ->
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_arrow B1 B2)
 | D_andL : forall (A1 A2 B:styp),
     disjoint A1 B ->
     disjoint A2 B ->
     disjoint (styp_and A1 A2) B
 | D_andR : forall (A B1 B2:styp),
     disjoint A B1 ->
     disjoint A B2 ->
     disjoint A (styp_and B1 B2)
 | D_rcdEq : forall (l:i) (A B:styp),
     disjoint A B ->
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B)
 | D_rcdNeq : forall (l1:i) (A:styp) (l2:i) (B:styp),
      l1  <>  l2  ->
     disjoint (styp_rcd l1 A) (styp_rcd l2 B)
 | D_axNatArr : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint styp_nat (styp_arrow A1 A2)
 | D_axArrNat : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat
 | D_axNatRcd : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint styp_nat (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdNat : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat
 | D_axArrRcd : forall (A1 A2:styp) (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdArr : forall (l:i) (A A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) (styp_arrow A1 A2).

Inductive has_type : sctx -> sexp -> dirflag -> styp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | T_top : forall (GG:sctx),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG e_top Inf styp_top trm_unit
 | T_lit : forall (GG:sctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_lit i5) Inf styp_nat (trm_lit i5)
 | T_var : forall (GG:sctx) (x:var) (A:styp),
      uniq  GG  ->
      binds  x A GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_var_f x) Inf A (trm_var_f x)
 | T_app : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp) (A1:styp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Chk A1 e2 ->
     has_type GG (e_app ee1 ee2) Inf A2 (trm_app e1 e2)
 | T_merge : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A1 A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf A1 e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Inf A2 e2 ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     has_type GG (e_merge ee1 ee2) Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (trm_pair e1 e2)
 | T_rcd : forall (GG:sctx) (l:i) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf A e ->
     has_type GG (e_rcd l ee) Inf (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l e)
 | T_proj : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (l:i) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf (styp_rcd l A) e ->
     has_type GG (e_proj ee l) Inf A (trm_proj e l)
 | T_anno : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Chk A e ->
     has_type GG (e_anno ee A) Inf A e
 | T_abs : forall (L:vars) (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A B:styp) (e:exp),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> has_type  (( x ~ A )++ GG )   ( open_sexp_wrt_sexp ee (e_var_f x) )  Chk B  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x) )  )  ->
     has_type GG (e_abs ee) Chk (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs e)
 | T_sub : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (c:co) (e:exp) (B:styp),
     has_type GG ee Inf B e ->
     sub B A c ->
     has_type GG ee Chk A (trm_capp c e).

Inductive CTyp : C -> sctx -> dirflag -> styp -> sctx -> dirflag -> styp -> cc -> Prop :=
 | CTyp_empty1 : forall (GG:sctx) (A:styp),
     CTyp C_Empty GG Inf A GG Inf A cc_Empty
 | CTyp_empty2 : forall (GG:sctx) (A:styp),
     CTyp C_Empty GG Chk A GG Chk A cc_Empty
 | CTyp_appL1 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp) (A1:styp),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Chk A1 e ->
     CTyp (C_AppL C5 ee2) GG Inf A GG' Inf A2 (cc_AppL cc5 e)
 | CTyp_appL2 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp) (A1:styp),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Chk A1 e ->
     CTyp (C_AppL C5 ee2) GG Chk A GG' Inf A2 (cc_AppL cc5 e)
 | CTyp_appR1 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc) (A1:styp),
     has_type GG' ee1 Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) e ->
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Chk A1 cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_AppRd ee1 C5) GG Inf A GG' Inf A2 (cc_AppR e cc5)
 | CTyp_appR2 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc) (A1:styp),
     has_type GG' ee1 Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) e ->
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Chk A1 cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_AppRd ee1 C5) GG Chk A GG' Inf A2 (cc_AppR e cc5)
 | CTyp_mergeL1 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf A1 cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Inf A2 e ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     CTyp (C_MergeL C5 ee2) GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (cc_PairL cc5 e)
 | CTyp_mergeL2 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf A1 cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Inf A2 e ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     CTyp (C_MergeL C5 ee2) GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (cc_PairL cc5 e)
 | CTyp_mergeR1 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc),
     has_type GG' ee1 Inf A1 e ->
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf A2 cc5 ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     CTyp (C_MergeR ee1 C5) GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (cc_PairR e cc5)
 | CTyp_mergeR2 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc),
     has_type GG' ee1 Inf A1 e ->
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf A2 cc5 ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     CTyp (C_MergeR ee1 C5) GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (cc_PairR e cc5)
 | CTyp_rcd1 : forall (l:i) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (B:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf B cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Rcd l C5) GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_rcd l B) (cc_Rcd l cc5)
 | CTyp_rcd2 : forall (l:i) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (B:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf B cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Rcd l C5) GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_rcd l B) (cc_Rcd l cc5)
 | CTyp_proj1 : forall (C5:C) (l:i) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (B:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_rcd l B) cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Proj C5 l) GG Inf A GG' Inf B (cc_Proj cc5 l)
 | CTyp_proj2 : forall (C5:C) (l:i) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (B:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_rcd l B) cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Proj C5 l) GG Chk A GG' Inf B (cc_Proj cc5 l)
 | CTyp_anno1 : forall (C5:C) (A:styp) (GG:sctx) (B:styp) (GG':sctx) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf B GG' Chk A cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Anno C5 A) GG Inf B GG' Inf A cc5
 | CTyp_anno2 : forall (C5:C) (A:styp) (GG:sctx) (B:styp) (GG':sctx) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk B GG' Chk A cc5 ->
     CTyp (C_Anno C5 A) GG Chk B GG' Inf A cc5
 | CTyp_abs1 : forall (x:var) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A  (( x ~ A1 )++ GG' )  Chk A2 cc5 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  GG' )  ->
     CTyp (C_Lam x C5) GG Inf A GG' Chk (styp_arrow A1 A2) (cc_Lam x cc5)
 | CTyp_abs2 : forall (x:var) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A  (( x ~ A1 )++ GG' )  Chk A2 cc5 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  GG' )  ->
     CTyp (C_Lam x C5) GG Chk A GG' Chk (styp_arrow A1 A2) (cc_Lam x cc5).

Inductive cotyp : co -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | cotyp_refl : forall (T:typ),
     cotyp co_id T T
 | cotyp_trans : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T3 T2:typ),
     cotyp c1 T2 T3 ->
     cotyp c2 T1 T2 ->
     cotyp (co_trans c1 c2) T1 T3
 | cotyp_top : forall (T:typ),
     cotyp co_top T a_unit
 | cotyp_topArr :
     cotyp co_topArr a_unit (a_arrow a_unit a_unit)
 | cotyp_arr : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T2 T1' T2':typ),
     cotyp c1 T1' T1 ->
     cotyp c2 T2 T2' ->
     cotyp (co_arr c1 c2) (a_arrow T1 T2) (a_arrow T1' T2')
 | cotyp_pair : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T2 T3:typ),
     cotyp c1 T1 T2 ->
     cotyp c2 T1 T3 ->
     cotyp (co_pair c1 c2) T1 (a_prod T2 T3)
 | cotyp_distArr : forall (T1 T2 T3:typ),
     cotyp co_distArr (a_prod  (a_arrow T1 T2)   (a_arrow T1 T3) ) (a_arrow T1 (a_prod T2 T3))
 | cotyp_projl : forall (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp co_proj1 (a_prod T1 T2) T1
 | cotyp_projr : forall (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp co_proj2 (a_prod T1 T2) T2
 | cotyp_rcd : forall (l:i) (c:co) (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp c T1 T2 ->
     cotyp (co_rcd l c) (a_rcd l T1) (a_rcd l T2)
 | cotyp_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     cotyp (co_topRcd l) a_unit (a_rcd l a_unit)
 | cotyp_distRcd : forall (l:i) (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp (co_distRcd l) (a_prod (a_rcd l T1) (a_rcd l T2)) (a_rcd l (a_prod T1 T2)).

Inductive typing : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | typ_unit : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     typing G trm_unit a_unit
 | typ_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     typing G (trm_lit i5) a_nat
 | typ_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x T G  ->
     typing G (trm_var_f x) T
 | typ_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (e:exp) (T1 T2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing  (( x ~ T1 )++ G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x) )  T2 )  ->
     typing G (trm_abs e) (a_arrow T1 T2)
 | typ_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (a_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (trm_app e1 e2) T2
 | typ_pair : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (T1 T2:typ),
     typing G e1 T1 ->
     typing G e2 T2 ->
     typing G (trm_pair e1 e2) (a_prod T1 T2)
 | typ_capp : forall (G:ctx) (c:co) (e:exp) (T' T:typ),
     typing G e T ->
     cotyp c T T' ->
     typing G (trm_capp c e) T'
 | typ_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (l:i) (e:exp) (T:typ),
     typing G e T ->
     typing G (trm_rcd l e) (a_rcd l T)
 | typ_proj : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (l:i) (T:typ),
     typing G e (a_rcd l T) ->
     typing G (trm_proj e l) T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | value_unit :
     value trm_unit
 | value_lit : forall (i5:i),
     value (trm_lit i5)
 | value_abs : forall (e:exp),
     lc_exp (trm_abs e) ->
     value (trm_abs e)
 | value_pair : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value (trm_pair v1 v2)
 | value_rcd : forall (l:i) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_rcd l v)
 | value_cabs : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp  ( (co_arr c1 c2) )  v)
 | value_cpair : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp co_distArr v)
 | value_topArr : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp co_topArr v).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_id : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp co_id v) v
 | step_trans : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp  ( (co_trans c1 c2) )  v) (trm_capp c1  ( (trm_capp c2 v) ) )
 | step_top : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp co_top v) trm_unit
 | step_topArr :
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp co_topArr trm_unit) )  trm_unit) trm_unit
 | step_arr : forall (c1 c2:co) (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp  ( (co_arr c1 c2) )  v1) )  v2) (trm_capp c2  ( (trm_app v1  ( (trm_capp c1 v2) ) ) ) )
 | step_pair : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp (co_pair c1 c2) v) (trm_pair (trm_capp c1 v) (trm_capp c2 v))
 | step_distArr : forall (v1 v2 v3:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value v3 ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp co_distArr (trm_pair v1 v2)) )  v3) (trm_pair (trm_app v1 v3) (trm_app v2 v3))
 | step_projl : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp co_proj1 (trm_pair v1 v2)) v1
 | step_projr : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp co_proj2 (trm_pair v1 v2)) v2
 | step_crcd : forall (l:i) (c:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp (co_rcd l c) (trm_rcd l v)) (trm_rcd l (trm_capp c v))
 | step_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     step (trm_capp (co_topRcd l) trm_unit) (trm_rcd l trm_unit)
 | step_distRcd : forall (l:i) (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp (co_distRcd l) (trm_pair (trm_rcd l v1) (trm_rcd l v2))) (trm_rcd l (trm_pair v1 v2))
 | step_projRcd : forall (l:i) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_proj (trm_rcd l v) l) v
 | step_beta : forall (e v:exp),
     lc_exp (trm_abs e) ->
     value v ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_abs e) )  v)  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e v )
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (trm_app e1 e2) (trm_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (trm_app v1 e2) (trm_app v1 e2')
 | step_pair1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (trm_pair e1 e2) (trm_pair e1' e2)
 | step_pair2 : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (trm_pair v1 e2) (trm_pair v1 e2')
 | step_capp : forall (c:co) (e e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_capp c e) (trm_capp c e')
 | step_rcd1 : forall (l:i) (e e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_rcd l e) (trm_rcd l e')
 | step_rcd2 : forall (e:exp) (l:i) (e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_proj e l) (trm_proj e' l).
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory Infrastructure target_inf.

Definition kleene_equiv t1 t2 :=
  exists k, t1 ->* (trm_lit k) /\ t2 ->* (trm_lit k).

Fixpoint appctx (ctx : cc) (t : exp) : exp :=
  match ctx with
  | cc_Empty => t
  | cc_Lam x c => trm_abs (close_exp_wrt_exp x (appctx c t))
  | cc_AppL c t2 => trm_app (appctx c t) t2
  | cc_AppR t1 c => trm_app t1 (appctx c t)
  | cc_PairL c t2 => trm_pair (appctx c t) t2
  | cc_PairR t1 c => trm_pair t1 (appctx c t)
  | cc_Co co c => trm_capp co (appctx c t)
  | cc_Rcd l c => trm_rcd l (appctx c t)
  | cc_Proj c l => trm_proj (appctx c t) l
  end.

Definition relation := exp -> exp -> Prop.

Section Star.

Variable R : relation.

Inductive star: relation :=
  | star_refl: forall a,
      star a a
  | star_step: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> star a c.
